description: Fixed evaluation set. Each question has a list of FACTS (evidence); each fact names its source document and one or more verbatim answer-bearing spans (alternatives found by searching the whole source document for every passage that states the fact). A chunk is RELEVANT iff it comes from a fact's source and its NFKC/whitespace-collapsed/case-folded text contains any of that fact's spans. Labels are therefore independent of chunk size/overlap. Unanswerable questions have no evidence; expected behaviour is a refusal.
